conrad4:

So it's a seperate deck?  I am getting confused again. 

Each member of the V5 has a unique deck yes. But the V5 is still considered 1 "Villain" from the card-game perspective. Maybe calling each gameplay experience a villain 'encounter' might be less confusing, in which case the V5 are 1 encounter using multiple decks. You can't take single members of the Ennead and fight them by themselves, they come as a team. This follows that same idea but executes it in a different way.
